steps.title: Join
steps.text: This block sticks two pieces of text together, like “Hello ” and a name.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “say Hello!” block to your code area. Drag “join apple banana” into the “Hello!” box, type your own words, then click the block.

waitFor.label: Drag the “join” block into the “say” block

steps.title: Pick random
steps.text: This block gives a different number every time, between the two numbers you choose. Use it for surprises.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “go to x: y:” block to your code area. Drag “pick random 1 to 10” into the “x” box, change it to “-200 to 200”, then click the block a few times.

waitFor.label: Drag the “pick random” block into the “go to” block

steps.title: Greater than
steps.text: This block is true when the first number is bigger than the second. “<” and “=” work the same way. Use them in an “if” block.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block and an “if” block to your code area. Drag “>” into the “if” condition, then click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “>” block into the “if” condition
